parquet_storage.scope: Committed live Parquet files at the verified snapshot. Compression ratio sums encoded column-chunk uncompressed/compressed page bytes, including page headers once per leaf column/row group; not CSV/raw logical/RAM/allocated-disk compression. File/footer bytes are separate. Native counters are cumulative within this verifier container and include earlier full-body exports; duration covers only storage measurement/setup/save preparation.

operation_summary.scope: Derived observations only, not a correctness verdict or capacity benchmark. Seed is separate. Counts use native start/end phase labels; rates use host phase durations. Crossing-phase requests retain both labels. Failed and successful latencies stay separate.
operation_summary.read_attempt_boundary: Read journals are written after completion; an interrupted in-flight read can be absent. Do not interpret recorded read counts as every attempted read.

compression.scope: Sum of uncompressed/compressed Parquet column-chunk bytes for unique live files at one explicit committed snapshot. After encoding, including page headers; not CSV/raw application bytes, RSS or allocated disk. Verification qualification remains separate.

codec_level.reason: Parquet footer records codec, not writer level; no explicit level override is used in this profile.

observer_error.error: Observer attempted exclusive-create over its own start record after the native Make command returned. Original start record and command log preserved.
observer_error.fixed_observer: Uses a separate immutable .result.json completion record for subsequent commands.

limitations: One functional trial, fixed pacing and small percentile samples; no capacity or comparative winner claim.
Recent/historical acknowledged reads do not establish cold OS or engine caches.
Request timers include setup/query/fetch/validation/close as documented; configured cancellation is not qualified as a strict native deadline.
Parquet ratio is encoded uncompressed/compressed column-chunk bytes; not input/CSV/RAM/allocated-disk compression.
Sampler excludes unobserved edges and cannot bridge restarts; native process/cgroup counters complement samples.
Recovery readers can use cached complete snapshots; successful outage reads are not a general fresh-data availability claim.
Original failed run remains failed; later passing data preservation cannot replace its verdict.
Separate catalog/S3/network, compactor, TTL/archive faults, backup/restore and disk loss remain unqualified.
resource_scope_notes: Native cgroup CPU across all threads including probes; sampled charged memory and per-generation lifetime peak. Intervals use native /proc/uptime with centisecond resolution; full probe brackets retain uncertainty. Approximate du allocated bytes, not open-deleted or unique physical storage. Workload /results binds share one witness directory: do not sum them. Device I/O is Docker-VM accounting, not physical SSD latency/queue depth; do not sum stacked devices. Missing devices/counters are unavailable, not zero. CPU and byte/IOPS deltas exclude restart bridges and unobserved initial/final edges. Raw samples retain network counters and timing uncertainty.
lifecycle_note: docker-up/up/test/down/docker-down completed across documented instrumentation fixes. Not an uninterrupted first-attempt pass or the full production matrix.
